entries.what: Caught the 6:48 Tule Line from Flats Junction with a large masala chai from Anh's cart, then sat through his MWF morning classes at Bayshore State.
entries.outcome: Made it to class on time and spent the ride rereading his Harrowgate notes.

entries.what: Worked his front desk shift at the Bayshore career center and put final touches on the ops management tote-flow project.
entries.outcome: Project slides finished except for the summary page.

entries.what: Back at unit 132, quietly ate rajma from his meal prep and edited the spreadsheet until after 1 a.m. while Marcus was at Ridgeline.
entries.outcome: Updated the tracker, went to bed around 2.

entries.what: Took the 6:48 north, then sat in Dr. Ashby's Tuesday 10:30 operations management class.
entries.outcome: Took notes on the final review topics.

entries.what: Had his standing Tuesday 3 p.m. mock interview with Lena, answering 'tell me about yourself' on his feet, then rehashed it for the Harrowgate round that evening.
entries.outcome: Got feedback on pacing; felt steadier even though nervous.

entries.what: Joined the second-round video interview with Harrowgate Distribution from his bedroom wearing the navy blazer and his dad's tie.
entries.outcome: Finished the interview with no idea how it went.

entries.what: Texted Sunita and his mom a short summary of the interview and went to bed earlier than usual.
entries.outcome: Sunita sent encouragement referencing her contact.

entries.what: Submitted the ops management group project a full day before the Nov 20 due date and asked for a checklist to use on the next one because he likes finishing ahead.
entries.outcome: Project turned in early; checklist drafted for next time.

entries.what: Got a follow-up from Harrowgate saying a decision would come by mid-December, and logged it in the spreadsheet.
entries.outcome: Now waiting with nothing to do but keep applying elsewhere.

entries.what: Rode the train home and picked up groceries at Ruiz Family Market before an evening of lo-fi and LinkedIn outreach to one alum.
entries.outcome: One alum message sent.

entries.what: Went to Dr. Ashby's Thursday class and then stopped by his 2 p.m. office hours to thank him for the letter.
entries.outcome: Ashby said the letter was already sent.

entries.what: Paid up his week's chai tab with Anh on the way home.
entries.outcome: Tab settled.

entries.what: Did laundry at the card-only room in Marisol Gardens on Thursday night.
entries.outcome: Clothes clean for the weekend.

entries.what: Morning classes at Bayshore, then lunch with classmates in the supply chain club.
entries.outcome: Omar mentioned his internship again; Arjun let it pass.

entries.what: Worked the career center desk for his ten hours' share and sent two more applications.
entries.outcome: Tracker updated.

entries.what: Quiet Friday night at unit 132 with Marcus before his shift, splitting leftover rice.
entries.outcome: Marcus left for Ridgeline around 9.

entries.what: Ran the Delgado Park loop in the morning instead of the flooded marsh boardwalk.
entries.outcome: Finished about four miles.

entries.what: Went to the gurdwara on Pell Road for the Thanksgiving food drive and helped his mom pack boxes of groceries.
entries.outcome: Packed boxes for the afternoon; Gurpreet asked about the CDL again.

entries.what: Evening at his parents' house for dinner and dal to take home.
entries.outcome: Brought a tub back to the apartment.

entries.what: Slept in, then prepped four containers of rajma and rice for the week.
entries.outcome: Food ready for Monday.

entries.what: Helped Sunita update the wedding vendor spreadsheet at the Sunday family dinner.
entries.outcome: Vendor sheet current.

entries.what: Took his mother's Sunday call about internships, telling her Harrowgate said mid-December.
entries.outcome: She promised not to ask until December.
